records.title: bitcoin.org domain is registered
records.summary: The bitcoin.org domain was registered on 18 August 2008, more than two months before the whitepaper announcement.
records.significance: It is the earliest clear public infrastructure footprint associated with the Bitcoin project.

records.title: Satoshi Nakamoto publishes the Bitcoin whitepaper
records.summary: Satoshi Nakamoto posted Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System to the Cryptography Mailing List on 31 October 2008.
records.significance: The whitepaper publicly introduced Bitcoin's design for peer-to-peer electronic cash without a trusted financial intermediary.

sources.title: Cryptography Mailing List — Bitcoin P2P e-cash paper

records.title: Cryptographers debate Bitcoin's assumptions after its announcement
records.summary: The first Cryptography Mailing List thread contains immediate technical questions and skepticism about Bitcoin's scaling, double spending, proof of work and incentives.
records.significance: The discussion shows Bitcoin was challenged from its first public appearance rather than instantly accepted.
